posts.title: I’m “Done” with Dev Containers
posts.description: Well… that didn’t last long Back in March I wrote about crib , yet another dev environment tool I built after years of not hacking on this kinda stuff in the open. The Dev Container spec really felt like the right foundation: I didn’t have to invent my own format or special configuration anymore, just build a runner that worked the way I wanted.
